slides.title: 480 gallons at 10 AM. When does it hit ==zero==?

slides.stem: A pool holds 480 gallons at 10:00 AM and 210 gallons at 1:00 PM, draining at a constant rate. At what time will the pool be empty?
slides.prompt: Time yourself. Comment your time and your answer.

slides.title: C — 3:20 PM
slides.body: Drain rate = (480 − 210)/3 = 90 gal/hr. Most students pick A (2:20 PM): drops the 1-hour gap and adds 2:20 to 12 PM-style reasoning.

slides.title: Linear Model to Find Zero Time
slides.body: For draining models, find the rate first, anchor at the most recent known point, then solve for when the amount hits 0 — and convert decimal hours into hours and minutes.
